name: tagpilot-mcp-servers
description: Tag Pilot's free, read-only MCP servers for Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e --workspace packages/ga4-mcp --workspace packages/search-console-mcp
scripts.mcpb: npm run build && node scripts/build-mcpb.mjs ga4-mcp && node scripts/build-mcpb.mjs search-console-mcp
scripts.mcpb:smoke: node scripts/mcpb-smoke.mjs ga4-mcp && node scripts/mcpb-smoke.mjs search-console-mcp
